summary: Lincoln County, MT Kootenai NF crow's nest site from 1936; FFLA lists it as abandoned, not gone; firelookout.com says still there in the 1980s; no source describes it today.

facts.design: Two crow's nests, about a quarter mile apart on the ridgetop
facts.status_note: FFLA lists it as Abandoned, not gone. firelookout.com says it was still there in the 1980s. No source describes its current condition.

events.note: firelookout.com describes two crow's nests; Forest Lookouts describes a tree observation post established in the same year

evidence.supports: two crow's nests about a quarter mile apart on the ridgetop, 1936
evidence.quote: 1936: 2 crows nests 1/4 mile apart on ridgetop

evidence.supports: about seven miles south-southwest of Eureka
the 1936 work is called a tree observation post
FFLA lists its type as Crowsnest and its status as Abandoned, not gone

corrections.why: FFLA lists Virginia Hill as Abandoned, not gone, and firelookout.com says it was still there in the 1980s. No source says it was destroyed or removed.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com describes two crow's nests about a quarter mile apart; the Forest Lookouts county listing gives the same year and calls the work a tree observation post. Both wordings are kept in the story.

notes_for_editor: The brief's status 'gone' is contradicted by both listings: FFLA gives Abandoned and firelookout.com says it was still there in the 1980s. The correction proposes 'unknown'. The Forest Lookouts Lincoln County page adds only the 1936 tree observation post line. The 1940s abandonment has no exact year, so no abandoned event is entered. Its kind 'platform' fits the crow's nests description. Used 2 WebSearch calls and 2 page reads.
